memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “The entirety of Your word is truth, and every one of Your righteous judgments endures forever.” — Psalm 119:160

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
In today's world, 'truth' has become something that changes according to each person's perspective. The mindset that "whatever seems right to me is the truth" has taken deep root. However, for believers, we must establish 'True Truth.' This is something that does not change with time; it does not change according to circumstances.

No matter how tall a building is, if its foundation is not strong, it will collapse. Our spiritual life is exactly the same. What are we standing on? Is it our emotions? Or is it the Truth?

Recently, a young man, heartbroken by problems in his family, was pushed to a state where he thought God did not exist. A minister told him, "Your feelings will change, but God's Word will not change. It does not matter how you feel; what God says is the Truth." When he placed his trust again on that 'True Truth,' although his circumstances did not change immediately, the state of his heart changed. Fear vanished, and hope blossomed.

Truth is not merely a philosophy; it is a Person—Jesus Christ. He said, "I am the way, the truth, and the life." If we walk with Him, we walk on the path of truth. It is this truth that sets us free.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Hiding from the truth is cowardice; bowing before the truth is wisdom.” — Bishop J.C. Ryle

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, establish us upon Your Word, which is truth, so that we may not become slaves to the lies of this world. Grant us the grace to walk in Your unchanging truth, even when times change. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: If you build on sand, the house will fall; if you build on rock, the house will stand.
Emotions are like sand; Truth is like rock.
What you stand on determines the future of your life. Stand firm on 'True Truth.'
